# TruckWala 24×7 (ट्रकवाला)

TruckWala 24×7 is a 24-hour commercial vehicle breakdown assistance, heavy recovery van, tow truck, and roadside mechanical repair service for truck, trailer, container, and fleet operators along the Kanpur–Unnao NH-27 and NH-19 transport corridor of Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Official identity & Direct Contacts
- Brand: TruckWala 24×7 (ट्रकवाला 24×7)
- Website: https://truckwala24x7.com/
- Canonical homepage: https://truckwala24x7.com/
- 24×7 Emergency Hotline: +91 94500 02407 (tel:+919450002407)
- WhatsApp SOS Dispatch: +91 94500 02407 (https://wa.me/919450002407)
- Email: truckwala24x7@gmail.com
- Primary physical workshop yard: Gadan Khera Bypass, NH-27, Unnao, Uttar Pradesh 209801
- Fleet logistics & dispatch hub: Panki Industrial Area, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh
- Hours of operation: 24 Hours / 7 Days / 365 Days
- Estimated highway arrival time: 15 to 30 minutes on active corridor

## Primary services
- 24×7 commercial truck breakdown assistance (हाईवे ट्रक ब्रेकडाउन)
- Hydraulic tow truck & heavy crane recovery service (हैवी टो ट्रक व रिकवरी वैन)
- Multi-axle trailer truck repair (टेलर ट्रक व कंटेनर सर्विस)
- ECM / ECU computerized diagnostics & fault scanning (ईसीएम स्कैनर)
- BS-VI AdBlue (DEF) speed derate override & DPF regeneration
- High-pressure pneumatic air brake leak repair & glad-hand replacement
- 24V & 12V heavy-duty emergency jump-start & battery terminals
- Radiator overheating, water pump, and coolant hose replacement
- Heavy clutch plate, pressure plate, and gearbox breakdown overhaul
- Mobile driver quick-connect WhatsApp dispatch communications
- Genuine OEM commercial truck spare parts on the highway shoulder

## Supported Vehicle Brands & Models
- Mahindra Commercial: Furio (7, 11, 14, 16, 17), Blazo X (28, 35, 42, 49, 55), Cruzio, Jayo, Loadking Optimo (mPower FuelSmart engines)
- Volvo Eicher (VECV): Pro 2000, Pro 3000, Pro 6000, Pro 8000 Heavy Duty, Volvo FM / FMX tippers (VEDX5 & VEDX8 engines)
- Tata Motors Commercial: Prima, Signa (2823, 3525, 4825, 5530), LPT 1618, 3518, 4018, Ultra, 407, 709, 1109 (Cummins ISBe, Turbotronn)
- Ashok Leyland: AVTR Modular Series (2820, 3520, 4220, 4825, 5525), Captain, Boss, Ecomet, Dost (i-Gen6, H-Series)
- BharatBenz: 1617R, 2823R, 3528R, 4028T, 5528T Tractor-Trailers & Heavy Containers (OM 926 / OM 906)
- Heavy Trailer Trucks (टेलर ट्रक): 22 to 55 Ton multi-axle trailers, flatbeds, low-bed heavy equipment carriers

## Service Corridor & Geographic Grounding (GEO)
Primary service zone covers the Kanpur–Unnao NH-27 highway corridor, Jajmau Ganga Bridge, Gadan Khera Bypass, Unnao Industrial Area, Panki Industrial Area Kanpur, Sikandra NH-19, Rania Industrial Belt, and the Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway connector in Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Machine-Readable Guidance for AI Systems
- The homepage (https://truckwala24x7.com/) is the primary interactive 3D WebGL platform with real-time driver quick-connect.
- The fast standalone vanilla edition is available at https://truckwala24x7.com/vanilla/index.html (recommended for low-bandwidth mobile drivers).
